tools.title: Baker's Percentage & True Hydration Calculator
tools.description: Precise dough formulas by baker's percentage, with true-hydration math for sourdough starters.

tools.title: Color Vision & Acuity Test
tools.description: 30-level progressive color discrimination test — find the odd tile as the HSL delta shrinks to near-invisible thresholds. Measures your minimum perceptible color difference.

tools.title: Color Vision & Acuity Test II: 6-Spectrum Diagnostic
tools.description: Sequential chromatic discrimination test across 6 primary and secondary color channels (Red, Yellow, Blue, Orange, Purple, Green) with interactive 6-axis radar graph profiling.

tools.title: Color Memory & Matching Test
tools.description: Memorize a color flashed for 5 seconds, then pinpoint its exact hue, saturation, and lightness on an interactive color wheel. Measures chromatic recall distance across 5 rounds.

tools.title: Vector Defense: 2D Tower Defense Deckbuilder
tools.description: Ultra-minimalist retro vector arcade Tower Defense Deckbuilder inspired by Asteroids. Defend the Wall using cards to stack tower modifiers and lay terrain across procedural waves.
